purpose: Rank event families by structural inequality of information sets before public/common revelation, independently from operational feasibility and ARGOS performance.

construct_boundary.rule: F1-F9 may re-enter only after IAS/SMAA ranking is frozen, as a separate W3 feasibility layer.

PAC.name: Privileged Access Concentration
PAC.question: How strongly does the event-generation process create a bounded group with earlier access to material state information?

anchors.0: decisive information public; no earlier process access
anchors.2: diffuse earlier access or only partial non-decisive state
anchors.3: bounded multi-party group has earlier access to material partial state
anchors.4: small bounded group has earlier access to material or near-decisive state
anchors.5: highly concentrated decision/control set knows or determines decisive state well before public revelation

LSO.name: Latent-State Opacity
LSO.question: How much outcome-determining state evolves outside continuous public observation?

anchors.1: mostly public with minor latent component
anchors.2: latent component constrained by frequent public updates
anchors.3: material latent state between intermittent public updates
anchors.4: most decisive state evolves in private/internal/negotiation/regulatory process
anchors.5: decisive state is fundamentally opaque until a discrete revelation

SIB.name: Specialized Interpretation Barrier
SIB.question: How much specialized expertise is required to interpret the relevant state before broad public understanding?

anchors.3: substantial professional expertise and multi-source interpretation
anchors.5: highly specialized, case-specific expertise difficult even for outside professionals

TAW.name: Temporal Asymmetry Window
TAW.question: How long can a meaningful process-based informational advantage plausibly exist before common/public revelation? Prediction-market contract lead time is forbidden.

PSI.name: Public Saturation Inverse
PSI.question: How weak is standardized public forecasting/monitoring relative to event uncertainty? Higher means weaker saturation.

anchors.0: near-continuous dense monitoring and standardized forecasts across multiple independent channels
anchors.1: dense consensus plus multiple independent public signals/forecast channels
anchors.2: broad coverage and standardized forecasts but material idiosyncratic uncertainty
anchors.4: sparse specialist coverage with limited standardized forecasting
anchors.5: little or no standardized pre-event forecasting

PSI.low_anchor_guardrail: PSI 0 or 1 requires at least two distinct observable public forecast/information channels.

A.definition: direct same-family high-quality empirical/institutional evidence plus independent process or empirical corroboration
A.score_uncertainty: triangular clipped to [0,5] centered on anchor with half-width 0.5

B.definition: strong same-family mechanism or empirical evidence with a material limitation
B.score_uncertainty: triangular clipped to [0,5] centered on anchor with half-width 1.0

C.score_uncertainty: triangular clipped to [0,5] centered on anchor with half-width 2.0

D.definition: insufficient evidence for a confident anchor

family_evidence_gate.failure_semantics: Family may remain visible but cannot support a comparative highest-asymmetry claim or W3 candidacy.

central_index.scale_semantics: quasi-interval descriptive summary; not treated as uniquely cardinal truth

smaa.weight_distribution: Dirichlet(1,1,1,1,1) over the full simplex via normalized iid Exp(1)
smaa.score_uncertainty: ECG-dependent distributions above; independent across family-dimension conditional on anchors/ECG
smaa.robust_high_rule: evidence_gate PASS AND IAS_central>=3.0 AND P_IAS_ge_3>=0.75

robustness.anchor_local_perturbation: ECG uncertainty is the primary probabilistic perturbation; no outcome-informed manual perturbation allowed
robustness.interpretation: Sensitivity outputs are descriptive robustness checks; they cannot change frozen anchors, thresholds or the primary SMAA rule.

forbidden: F1-F9 statuses as IAS score inputs

real_execution_sequence: freeze this protocol, source catalog, evidence ledger, scorer and synthetic tests
independent CI validates byte identities and synthetic archetypes without real aggregation output
only then join frozen F1-F9 for GO/NO-GO W3
prohibitions: No taxonomy merge/split after real IAS aggregation.
No weight, threshold, ECG, anchor or source adjustment after seeing IAS/SMAA ranking.
No family score informed by ARGOS or linked-asset performance.
No F1-F9 failure used to lower IAS.
No missing feasibility interpreted as low asymmetry.
No W3 execution before separate freeze.
